umbrella.modal_desc: Free umbrella lending service provided by the Student Committee (GOZ) when it rains. Students can request and return umbrellas at the specified location.
umbrella.location: GOZ Room, Mahachakri Sirindhorn Building, Floor M1
umbrella.rule1: Present student ID card or show your student profile screen to verify identity.
umbrella.rule2: Limit of 1 umbrella per person. Please return it within 3 business days.
umbrella.rule3: Late return or loss will be subject to Student Committee regulations.

pads.modal_desc: Emergency sanitary pads provided for students in need, set up inside restrooms across the Faculty of Arts as part of student welfare.
pads.location: Female Restrooms, Mahachakri Sirindhorn Building, Floors 1, 3, 5, and Borommarajakumari Building
pads.rule1: Grab instantly for emergency use with no charges.
pads.rule2: Please take only as needed for your immediate situation.
pads.rule3: If the box is empty, feel free to notify any GOZ committee member to refill.

medicine.modal_desc: Free basic household medicines and first-aid supplies for students experiencing mild symptoms or illness during study hours.
medicine.location: GOZ Room, Mahachakri Sirindhorn Building, Floor M1
medicine.meds_list: Paracetamol, Antihistamine, Antacid, Stomach mixture, basic bandages & wound cleaning kits
